== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tactical Support (Japanese)|Tactical Support]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/151452829/MflOzMBpp0ay1qvM9yX8ww.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 85187812.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4369216ddbf60a682d472a1b0c60f66f24d974cfc76da3134addb2622a8eaa2e</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
